title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question runs to about 200 words, well over the 120-word limit.
It recommends option 1 but never says what the harness will do if no answer comes.
The task ID T180JQ6 appears with no plain description, and code names like LIST_BUDGET, PAGE_SIZE, task_get and triggerType are left unexplained, as is jargon like 'guard moves'.
The task itself (adding two fields, triggerType and automatic, to each row of the tasks_list output) has to be pieced together; it is never stated plainly.
The reason for asking is clear: the estimated page size of about 3010 bytes would exceed the 2400-byte limit.
Each option mostly explains what it would mean in practice, such as more paging calls or dropping a field the owner asked for.
